title: High-Protein Blueberry Lemon Cheesecake | Creamy & Fresh #easyrecipe
description:
This high-protein blueberry lemon cheesecake is creamy, refreshing, and bursting with sweet blueberries and bright citrus flavor. Made with simple, protein-packed ingredients, it bakes into a silky cheesecake that's perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth while adding extra protein to your day.

Cottage cheese and Greek yogurt blend into a smooth, creamy base while the egg creates a classic cheesecake texture. Fresh lemon juice adds a bright, tangy flavor that perfectly complements the juicy blueberries baked into every bite, creating a light yet indulgent dessert.

This easy recipe is perfect for healthy desserts, meal prep, post-workout treats, spring and summer gatherings, or whenever you're craving a creamy cheesecake with a refreshing twist.

Ingredients
8 oz cottage cheese
1/4 cup Greek yogurt
1 large egg
Juice of 1/2 lemon
1/4 cup sweetener
Blueberries

Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Blend everything except the blueberries until smooth.
Grease two ramekins.
Pour in the batter.
Add the blueberries.
Bake for about 45 minutes.
Cool completely.
Chill before serving.
Enjoy.

Quick Tip
Chill for at least 2 hours before serving for the creamiest, smoothest cheesecake texture.

This blueberry lemon cheesecake is creamy, refreshing, and packed with bright citrus flavor in every bite.
